sounds.name: Whoosh left
sounds.notes: Air moving right to left. For a push to the left.

sounds.name: Whoosh right
sounds.notes: Air moving left to right. For a push to the right.

sounds.name: Whoosh up
sounds.notes: A bright, rising whoosh. For a push up.

sounds.name: Whoosh down
sounds.notes: A darker, falling whoosh. For a push down.

sounds.name: Soft whoosh
sounds.notes: A gentle, low whoosh that stays under the voice. A safe default for any push.

sounds.name: Fast whoosh
sounds.notes: A quick swipe for short, snappy pushes.

sounds.name: Long whoosh
sounds.notes: A slow pass of air for long or calm Transitions.

sounds.name: Airy whoosh
sounds.notes: Thin, bright air with little body. For light, minimal styles.

sounds.name: Deep whoosh
sounds.notes: A heavy, low rush. For dramatic Scene changes.

sounds.name: Swish
sounds.notes: A very short swish for quick cuts between related Scenes.

sounds.name: Zoom in
sounds.notes: A whoosh that builds to the end, as if flying into the next Scene. For a zoom-through.

sounds.name: Zoom out
sounds.notes: A whoosh that starts strong and trails off, as if pulling back. For a zoom-through out of detail.

sounds.name: Zoom through
sounds.notes: A full rise and fall that peaks in the middle. The default for a zoom-through.

sounds.name: Soft click
sounds.notes: A rounded, quiet click. The default for a crossfade.

sounds.name: Low click
sounds.notes: A muted, woody click for crossfades in calm videos.

sounds.name: Soft tick
sounds.notes: A tiny, high tick for crossfades that should barely be heard.

sounds.name: Crisp click
sounds.notes: A sharp interface click for crossfades in techy styles.

sounds.name: Plastic click
sounds.notes: A light plastic click, like a button press.

sounds.name: Tick
sounds.notes: A small mechanical tick for crossfades.

sounds.name: Select
sounds.notes: A short interface blip, like selecting an item.

sounds.name: Switch
sounds.notes: A switch flipping. For a crossfade between two views of the same thing.

sounds.name: Toggle
sounds.notes: A toggle click with a little body.

sounds.name: Pop open
sounds.notes: A quick upward pop, like a window opening. For a Scene that springs in.

sounds.name: Pop close
sounds.notes: A quick downward pop, like a window closing.

sounds.name: Slide open
sounds.notes: A mechanical sci-fi door sliding open. For a push in technical videos.

sounds.name: Slide close
sounds.notes: A mechanical sci-fi door sliding shut.

sounds.name: Heavy punch
sounds.notes: A big, solid hit. For the single most important number or claim.

sounds.name: Punch
sounds.notes: A medium hit. For a number landing or a strong word.

sounds.name: Soft thud
sounds.notes: A padded, heavy thud. For a reveal that should feel weighty but not loud.

sounds.name: Light thud
sounds.notes: A small soft thud. For list items or minor emphasis.

sounds.name: Metal hit
sounds.notes: A hard metallic clank. For something breaking, failing or locking.

sounds.name: Plate hit
sounds.notes: A ringing metal plate. For a warning or a hard limit.

sounds.name: Knock
sounds.notes: A dry wooden knock. For a plain, physical emphasis.

sounds.name: Bell strike
sounds.notes: A struck bell with a ring. A sting for a conclusion or the key takeaway.

sounds.name: Long bell strike
sounds.notes: A bell with a longer ring. A sting for the closing line.

sounds.name: Glass tap
sounds.notes: A light tap on glass. For something delicate or fragile.

sounds.name: Stone hit
sounds.notes: A pick striking rock. For digging into a detail.

sounds.name: Low boom
sounds.notes: A deep, distant boom. For a dramatic reveal or a big number.

sounds.name: Short boom
sounds.notes: A short low thump. For a stat landing.

sounds.name: Tech hit
sounds.notes: A sci-fi metallic impact. For systems, servers and hardware.

sounds.name: Force field
sounds.notes: A humming energy shimmer. For something switching on or a shield.

sounds.name: Crunch
sounds.notes: A crunchy explosion. For something crashing or being destroyed.

sounds.name: Confirm
sounds.notes: A positive interface chime. For a success, a fix or a yes.

sounds.name: Bright confirm
sounds.notes: A brighter success chime. For a win or a result that works.

sounds.name: Short confirm
sounds.notes: A short positive blip. For ticking off a step.

sounds.name: Ding
sounds.notes: A glassy ding. For an idea, a notification or a highlighted term.

sounds.name: Bong
sounds.notes: A low, round bong. For a key term appearing.

sounds.name: Pluck
sounds.notes: A short plucked note. For a light, friendly emphasis.

sounds.name: Drop
sounds.notes: A small drop sound. For an item falling into place.

sounds.name: Question
sounds.notes: A rising, questioning blip. For a question the video asks.

sounds.name: Error
sounds.notes: A short error buzz. For a mistake, a bug or a wrong answer.

sounds.name: Glitch
sounds.notes: A 20 ms digital glitch. For corruption, bugs or something going wrong.

sounds.name: Power up
sounds.notes: A rising retro power-up. For an upgrade or something getting faster.

sounds.name: Phaser up
sounds.notes: A rising retro phaser sweep. Game-like: use sparingly.

sounds.name: Three tones
sounds.notes: Three rising tones. For a three-part list landing or a sequence completing.

sounds.name: Two tones
sounds.notes: Two tones, like a notification. For a message or an alert.

sounds.name: Zap up
sounds.notes: An electric zap rising in three steps. For energy or a sudden change.

sounds.name: Blip up
sounds.notes: A small rising blip. For something increasing.

sounds.name: Blip down
sounds.notes: A small falling blip. For something decreasing.

sounds.name: Sub drop
sounds.notes: A deep falling tone. Felt more than heard, for a big reveal.

sounds.name: Riser
sounds.notes: Noise and a tone building for 1.5 s and stopping dead. Place it to end on the word it leads into.

sounds.name: Short riser
sounds.notes: A 0.8 s build that stops dead, to lead into a word.

sounds.name: Soft ding
sounds.notes: A pure, soft bell tone. A calm sting for a takeaway.
